title: Stretch Processor
text: Stretch processor for linear FM waveforms, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Specify PRF as} sets Source of PRF value; {Pulse width (s)} sets the time duration, {Pulse repetition frequency (Hz)} sets the pulse repetition frequency 1e4, {FM sweep slope (Hz/s)} sets the slope of linear FM, {FM sweep interval} sets the direction of FM, {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Reference range (m)} sets the center of ranges of interest, {Reference span (m)} sets the span of ranges of interest and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input signal M -by- P complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Stretch processed signal M -by- P complex-valued matrix

params.name: Pulse width (s)
params.values: Time duration of pulse 50e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Specify PRF as
params.values: Source of PRF value Property (default) | Auto | Input port

params.name: FM sweep slope (Hz/s)
params.values: Slope of linear FM sweep 2e9 (default) | scalar

params.name: FM sweep interval
params.values: Direction of FM sweep Positive (default) | Symmetric

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Reference range (m)
params.values: Center of ranges of interest 5000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reference span (m)
params.values: Span of ranges of interest 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
